definitions.explanation: the dried seed of the common bean plant, used in various dishes including soups, stews, and sweets
the immature pod of the same plant, eaten as a green vegetable, also called さやいんげん

notes:
Can be written in kanji as {隠元豆|いんげんまめ}, named after the Chinese Zen monk {隠元|いんげん} who is said to have brought the bean to Japan in the 17th century. In everyday use, the word can refer to either the dried bean (sense 1) or the green pod (sense 2), though the green pod is more precisely called ⟦さやいんげん→さやいんげん：24840_sayaingen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- いんげんまめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered kidney beans
- いんげんまめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧あえ: green beans with sesame dressing
- いんげんまめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉巻|にくま}き: green beans wrapped in meat
- いんげんまめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: green bean tempura

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さやいんげん→さやいんげん：24840_sayaingen⟧: green beans (pod) — specifically the fresh green pods
- ⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧: azuki bean — red bean used in Japanese sweets
- ⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧: soybean — larger bean central to Japanese cuisine
- ⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧: edamame — immature soybeans eaten as a snack
